Snow Warning.scope: Owner chooses Snow or Hail on entry; competing weather abilities use host-rolled Will, and source departure removes its weather.

Solar Power.scope: Reviewed encounter effects through the typed battlefield service; source, duration, suppression, host checks and rollback are tracked.

Solid Rock.scope: Reduce super-effective move damage by one.

Soul Heart.scope: A foe fainting from the user's damaging move grants one Strength or Special according to the definition, to a maximum of three.

Soundproof.scope: Immune to damage and added effects of moves marked SoundMove.

Speed Boost.scope: End of each active round adds one temporary Dexterity, capped at three; recall clears temporary counters.

Stakeout.scope: Witness active-slot replacement and add one damage to the first successful nonimmune attack on that incoming foe; track holders and targets independently, including Clash and reviewed formulas. Ice-block attacks do not consume the foe marker.

Stall.scope: Always sort last in initiative, including Trick Room and remaining-order changes; completed turns are not replayed.

Stalwart.scope: Bypass move/ability target redirection, including lures, attractors and support reflection. Cover is a separate maneuver.

Stamina.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Stance Change.scope: At round start select an exact Aegislash stance using its prepared rank/limit build. Blade allows only Physical/Special and Shield only Support; the highest HP/Will are shared.

Static.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues three chance dice; a six inflicts Paralysis.

Steadfast.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Steam Engine.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Steelworker.scope: Add one damage die for the definition's Rock, Steel, Bite, Cutter, non-ranged Physical or Wind move condition; use catalog tags rather than inferred move prose.

Steely Spirit.scope: In-range allies gain the reviewed one damage die, with Steely Spirit applying to Steel and including its user; duplicate damage bonuses do not stack.

Stench.scope: On a non-ranged Physical hit, the holder owner or GM resolves one host Chance Die to Flinch the attacker. Long Reach, Wonder Skin, source/target authority and existing status protections apply. Out-of-battle encounter-rate effects are excluded.

Sticky Hold.scope: Prevents reviewed involuntary held-item removal and exchange; explicit GM overrides retain their recorded reason.

Storm Drain.scope: Single-target Water redirection from any active participant, Water damage immunity and a first-hit Special +1 ability channel. Competing redirectors require a logged GM choice.

Strong Jaw.scope: Add one damage die for the definition's Rock, Steel, Bite, Cutter, non-ranged Physical or Wind move condition; use catalog tags rather than inferred move prose.

Sturdy.scope: Once per scene, ordinary damaging move or Clash damage that would faint the Pokemon leaves one HP. Indirect, self and reviewed set damage do not activate it.

Suction Cups.scope: Prevent forced switches originating from foes. Outside-battle capture/flavor effects remain manual.

Super Luck.scope: Reduce the accuracy-success margin needed for critical damage by one, including High Critical moves.

Supersweet Syrup.scope: Foes in confirmed range cannot Evade the holder moves; Clash remains available. Narrative encounter-rate changes remain GM adjudicated.

Supreme Overlord.scope: On entry gain one Strength and Special for each recorded fainted ally, maximum three.

Surge Surfer.scope: Reviewed encounter effects through the typed battlefield service; source, duration, suppression, host checks and rollback are tracked.

Swarm.scope: Ignore pain for Bug accuracy/damage; add two Bug damage dice at half HP or less.

Sweet Veil.scope: In-range user/allies are protected from the definition's Poison or Sleep ailment.

Swift Swim.scope: Reviewed encounter effects through the typed battlefield service; source, duration, suppression, host checks and rollback are tracked.

Sword of Ruin.scope: Reduce the named defense/attribute by two in confirmed rank-limited range. Ruin holders and relevant stat protections are exempt; duplicate auras do not stack.

Symbiosis.scope: Queues free owned-item handoffs after ally loss/consumption. Multiple donors and cycles require explicit GM ordering/rulings.

Synchronize.scope: Reflect source-tracked statuses once, respecting immunities. GM status edits without an inflictor have no inferred source.

Tablets of Ruin.scope: Reduce the named defense/attribute by two in confirmed rank-limited range. Ruin holders and relevant stat protections are exempt; duplicate auras do not stack.

Tangled Feet.scope: While confused, impose two reduced-accuracy successes on foe moves targeting the holder; Keen Eye prevents it. One shared roll saves independent success and critical results for each target through responses, damage ordering, persistence and rollback.

Tangling Hair.scope: The first hostile non-ranged Physical hit applies a sourced one-point Dexterity reduction to its attacker; Long Reach avoids it.

Technician.scope: Add one damage die for Physical/Special moves with Power 1 or 2; special/manual formulas remain adjudicated.

Telepathy.scope: Prevent damage from allied moves, while leaving hostile and condition damage unchanged.

Tera Shell.scope: Full-health Terapagos receives Not-Very-Effective Physical/Special move damage, including reviewed formula and Clash paths. The threshold is evaluated at damage time.

Tera Shift.scope: At round start choose the exact Terastal Terapagos form, restoring full HP/Will and statuses and materializing Tera Shell without replacing the permanent sheet.

Teraform Zero.scope: Active Terapagos removes supported battlefield effects, weather and terrain and suppresses ordinary abilities. Existing unique-ability protection remains; conflicting unique effects require a recorded GM ruling.

Teravolt.scope: Action-scoped foe type/damage/status immunity bypass, supported shields, decoys, redirection and charging-target access. Unique-effect stalemates, held items and unsupported effect blockers require GM adjudication.

Thermal Exchange.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Thick Fat.scope: Reduce Fire and Ice move damage by one.

Tinted Lens.scope: Ignore one individual foe type resistance, including one of a double resistance; preserve immunity and frozen attack identity.

Torrent.scope: Water accuracy/damage ignore pain at every HP level. GM chooses the conflicting text two-dice versus icon one-die bonus; the chosen Water damage-pool bonus applies at half HP or less and is frozen for shared damage. Support moves require no damage-bonus ruling.

Tough Claws.scope: Add one damage die for the definition's Rock, Steel, Bite, Cutter, non-ranged Physical or Wind move condition; use catalog tags rather than inferred move prose.

Toxic Boost.scope: While the reviewed ailment is present, add two Special, Strength or Dexterity respectively. Quick Feet also ignores paralysis effects.

Toxic Chain.scope: A hostile non-ranged Physical hit rolls the reviewed two/three chance dice for Poison/Badly Poisoned, respecting source-aware immunity and Wonder Skin.

Toxic Debris.scope: Non-ranged Physical hits scatter persistent Toxic Spikes on the foe side. New eligible entrants roll one host Chance die for Badly Poisoned, otherwise Poison; Ground immunity and status protection apply.

Trace.scope: Host-rolled random eligible foe on entry; copied ability activates through shared hooks and ends on departure. Unique abilities cannot be copied.

Transistor.scope: Add two damage dice for the definition's Dragon or Electric type.

Triage.scope: Reviewed Basic Heal and status-cure Support moves gain Reaction 1, including selected allies and multi-target cures. Existing action, capacity, target, Will and phase validation apply. Unsupported healing/cure definitions remain manual.

Truant.scope: On every second personal initiative turn, a declared action includes a Loyalty check requiring two successes. Failure forfeits only that turn, without spending the refused action or marking its move used. Success permits ordinary action validation. Out-of-turn reactions retain normal rules.

Turboblaze.scope: Action-scoped foe type/damage/status immunity bypass, supported shields, decoys, redirection and charging-target access. Unique-effect stalemates, held items and unsupported effect blockers require GM adjudication.

Unaware.scope: Ignore foe battle attribute increases and reductions when dealing or receiving damage, including derived defenses and reviewed speed-based damage; retain explicit defense channels, GM baselines and shared snapshots.

Unburden.scope: First loss/consumption leaving no held item adds two temporary Dexterity; rollback and encounter persistence preserve the once-only trigger.

Unnerve.scope: Active foes cannot consume held or recycled berries; saved second berry activations respect the same suppression.

Unseen Fist.scope: Non-ranged Physical Moves bypass Substitute/Shed Tail decoys. Remaining shield, force-field and Cover bypass hooks require implementation.

Vessel of Ruin.scope: Reduce the named defense/attribute by two in confirmed rank-limited range. Ruin holders and relevant stat protections are exempt; duplicate auras do not stack.

Victory Star.scope: Physical and Special moves of the user and living allies in confirmed range gain Never Miss.

Vital Spirit.scope: Immune to Sleep; unreviewed Rest/items remain manual.

Volt Absorb.scope: Immune to Electric damage; owner may restore one HP per hit, without an action or revival.

Wandering Spirit.scope: When the holder hits a foe with a non-ranged Physical move, exchange their effective ability identities. Does not trigger merely from receiving a hit. Unique abilities cannot be switched; contact assignments end on removal or scene end.

Water Absorb.scope: Immune to Water damage; owner may restore one HP per hit, without an action or revival.

Water Bubble.scope: Water moves gain two damage dice; reduce incoming Fire damage by one and ignore first/second Burn damage.

Water Compaction.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Weak Armor.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Well-Baked Body.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

White Smoke.scope: Protect the reviewed stat changes through sourced battle effects and supported moves; Clear Body also rejects external increases and Flower Veil protects in-range allies.

Wimp Out.scope: Crossing to half HP or less queues a controlled owner/GM reserve choice, ignoring Block. Switcher icon uses inherited initiative and remaining actions. One completed switcher effect per affected trainer per round; no reserve needs an explicit GM outcome.

Wind Power.scope: Qualifying wind-move damage charges the next Electric move for two damage dice without stacking. Shared damage snapshots preserve the charge across targets; Electric Support attempts consume it without granting Support dice.

Wind Rider.scope: Add one damage die for the definition's Rock, Steel, Bite, Cutter, non-ranged Physical or Wind move condition; use catalog tags rather than inferred move prose.

Wonder Guard.scope: Prevent non-super-effective move damage and supported indirect damage; condition damage still applies.

Wonder Skin.scope: Reduce chance dice for supported incoming added effects by two; independent selectors remain independent.

Zen Mode.scope: At round end at half HP or less use the exact regional Zen form with its own prepared rank-point build and limits; current battle resources are preserved.

Zero to Hero.scope: After recall prepare the exact Palafin Hero form and use that build on return; entry/switch identity, resources and rollback remain authoritative.
